data.name: Fatheey
data.gender_notes: Fatheey is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who gives life, the one who is the giver of blessings and sustenance. The name Fatheey carries the meaning “Giver of Life” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Fatheey usually hope their child will grow to embody giver of life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is believed to bring blessings and life to the family.
data.etymology: Fatheey belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Giver of Life.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fatheey total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: فاتحي
in_arabic.meaning: فاتحي تعني الفتح والنصر والتمكين من الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فاتحي مشتق من الفاتح، يعني الذي يفتح الله له أبواب الخير والنصر والتمكين، ويعني أيضًا من يفتح البصيرة والفهم لهم، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: {والفتح المبين}، ويعتبر اسم فاتحي من الأسماء ذات الأهمية الكبيرة في التراث الإسلامي.

in_urdu.name: فاتحی
in_urdu.meaning: فاتحی مطلب ہے فتح، فتحی، اور اللہ کی مدد
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام فاتحی عربی زبان کے لفظ 'فاتح' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے فتح پانے والا یا فتح دینے والا، اور یہ اللہ کی مدد اور اس کی فتح کا اشارہ کرتا ہے، یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں خاص اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خصوصاً فتح مکہ کے حوالے سے.

in_hindi.name: फतही
in_hindi.meaning: फतही का अर्थ है فتح, विजय, और ईश्वर की सहायता
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम फतही अरबी भाषा के शब्द 'فاتح' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है विजयी या विजय प्रदाता, और यह ईश्वर की सहायता और उसकी विजय की ओर संकेत करता है, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में विशेष महत्व रखता है, खासकर मक्का की विजय के संदर्भ में.

in_pashto.name: فتحي
in_pashto.meaning: فتحي معنی یې فتح، بریا، او د الله مدد
in_pashto.long_meaning: د فتحي نوم د عربي ژبې د کلمې 'فاتح' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د بريا کيدو یا بریا ورکولو څخه ده، او دا د الله تعالی د مرستې او د هغه د بریا اشاره کوي، دا نوم د اسلامي پېژندګلې په ځانګړي ډول د مکې د فتحې په تړاو کې مهم دی.

in_english.name: Fatheey
in_english.meaning: Fatheey means conquest, victory, and divine assistance
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fatheey is derived from the Arabic root 'F-T-Ḥ', which signifies opening, conquest, or victory. In Islamic tradition, it relates to one who achieves victory or triumph through divine support. The term 'Fatih' appears in the Quran, emphasizing its significance in Islamic heritage. The name Fatheey symbolizes success, divine aid, and the opening of doors to good fortune.

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل فاتحی
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل فتحي

data.cultural_impact: The name Fatheey holds significant cultural importance in the Islamic community. It is derived from the Arabic language, specifically from the root letters "F-T-H" which have the collective meaning of "giving life" or "giving sustenance." This name resonates with the values and teachings of Islam, which emphasize the importance of generosity, kindness, and providing for others. The name is also reminiscent of the Islamic concept of Allah (God) as the ultimate Giver, who provides for all of His creation.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Fatheey has deep spiritual significance for Muslims, as it reminds us of Allah's (God's) role as the ultimate source of life, sustenance, and blessings. It is a reminder of our dependence on Allah and the importance of being grateful for His blessings. The name also encourages us to emulate Allah's qualities of generosity and kindness, and to strive to be a source of blessing and sustenance for others. Additionally, the name suggests the idea of "fath" or "victory," which can be interpreted spiritually as the victory of the soul over the lower self, or the victory of righteousness over evil. Overall, the name Fatheey is a powerful reminder of Allah's compassion, generosity, and provision, and a call to emulate these qualities in our daily lives.

In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Fatheey serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of giver of life.
